decisions.reason: As a large R&D-intensive space-systems supplier, we have publicly committed to this camera on its own product page and it sits close to our core offer, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely absent clear failure evidence.
The modular navigation camera matches our stated strategic direction toward flexible and reprogrammable space sensors and was visibly launched on its own page, which supports continued commitment.

This sensor suite builds directly on our established capabilities and visible market presentation, so with no reported negative results we would likely continue backing it rather than admit an early reversal.

Although the miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR fits our move toward compact spacecraft sensors, the weaker website commitment means it is somewhat easier to discontinue than the others, but we would still more likely keep it for now.
